src.gen: A conference room in a snowy mountain town, tall windows showing snow outside, a man in a dark suit seated among a few colleagues in folding chairs, facing a stage
src.move: the seated men glance toward the stage as the room quiets

src.gen: A motivational speaker on a stage gripping a microphone, mouth wide open mid-shout, a conference room of seated people below, large screens on either side of the stage
src.move: the speaker on stage pounds the podium and shouts into the microphone

src.gen: A conference room full of seated people in rows, several leaning forward with mouths open shouting toward a stage, a tense crowded room
src.move: several people in the crowd rise halfway from their chairs and shout back toward the stage

src.gen: A man in a dark suit sitting calm and still in a folding chair, a blurred shouting crowd around him in a conference room, soft light
src.move: the seated man slowly shakes his head while the blurred crowd behind him keeps shouting
